baseline_enforcement_enabled.title: Baseline Configuration Enforcement Enabled
baseline_enforcement_enabled.description: Indicates whether an automated mechanism actively enforces approved configuration baselines across all system instances at deployment time.

compliance_scan_status.title: Baseline Compliance Scan Status
compliance_scan_status.description: The result of the most recent automated compliance scan comparing system configuration against the approved security baseline.

drift_detection_enabled.title: Configuration Drift Detection Enabled
drift_detection_enabled.description: Indicates whether continuous or scheduled monitoring is in place to detect deviations from the approved baseline after initial deployment.

baseline_definition_status.title: Baseline Definition Status
baseline_definition_status.description: Indicates whether a formal, versioned configuration baseline has been defined and is being used as the reference for drift comparisons.

alert_on_drift.title: Alerting on Drift Configured
alert_on_drift.description: Whether alerts or notifications are configured to fire when a deviation from the baseline configuration is detected.

detection_frequency_hours.title: Detection Scan Frequency (Hours)
detection_frequency_hours.description: How often (in hours) the drift detection scan runs. Lower values indicate more frequent and timely detection.

immutable_deployment_model.title: Immutable Deployment Model
immutable_deployment_model.description: Describes whether the infrastructure uses immutable/image-based instances (e.g., container images, VM snapshots, AMIs) that are replaced rather than modified in place.

in_place_modification_permitted.title: In-Place Modification Permitted
in_place_modification_permitted.description: Indicates whether runtime modifications (SSH access for config changes, package installs, file edits) to running instances are technically allowed and not blocked by policy or tooling.

artifact_integrity_validation_enabled.title: Artifact Integrity Validation Enabled
artifact_integrity_validation_enabled.description: Indicates whether cryptographic integrity checks (image signing, digest pinning, checksum verification) are enforced before deploying build artifacts to ensure only approved, unmodified images are used.

secrets_manager_integrated.title: Secrets Manager Integrated
secrets_manager_integrated.description: Indicates whether a secrets management solution (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) is integrated into the provisioning pipeline for injecting credentials at runtime.

hardcoded_secrets_detected.title: Hardcoded Secrets Detected
hardcoded_secrets_detected.description: Indicates whether any plaintext secrets, passwords, API keys, or tokens have been detected hardcoded in configuration files, IaC templates, scripts, or source code.

secret_injection_method.title: Secret Injection Method
secret_injection_method.description: The mechanism by which secrets are delivered to the environment at provisioning time.

auto_remediation_enabled.title: Automated Remediation Enabled
auto_remediation_enabled.description: Indicates whether the configuration management system is configured to automatically re-converge drifted systems to their intended state without manual intervention.

remediation_mode.title: Remediation Enforcement Mode
remediation_mode.description: The operational mode of the configuration enforcement system: whether it audits only, alerts, or actively enforces and remediates drift.

max_remediation_interval_minutes.title: Maximum Remediation Interval (Minutes)
max_remediation_interval_minutes.description: The maximum time in minutes between drift detection and automated re-convergence being triggered. Lower values indicate more responsive remediation.

environment_config_sync_status.title: Environment Configuration Sync Status
environment_config_sync_status.description: Indicates whether configuration parameters across development, staging, and production environments have been verified to be consistent and in parity with each other.

security_controls_reproduced_in_producti.title: Security Controls Reproduced in Production
security_controls_reproduced_in_producti.description: Indicates whether all security controls validated in lower environments (development and staging) are confirmed to be present and active in the production environment.

iac_enforcement_mechanism.title: IaC Enforcement Mechanism
iac_enforcement_mechanism.description: Describes whether environment provisioning is enforced through infrastructure-as-code tooling with automated drift detection, manual processes, or not enforced at all.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether audit logging for configuration changes is currently enabled and active on the system or platform.

logged_change_fields.title: Logged Change Fields
logged_change_fields.description: List of data fields captured per configuration change event, such as 'initiator', 'timestamp', 'previous_state', 'new_state'.

log_tamper_protection.title: Log Tamper Protection Mechanism
log_tamper_protection.description: The mechanism in place to prevent modification or deletion of audit logs after they are written.

policy_validation_enabled.title: Policy-as-Code Validation Enabled
policy_validation_enabled.description: Whether pre-deployment policy-as-code validation checks are actively enabled in the CI/CD or deployment pipeline.

validation_enforcement_mode.title: Validation Enforcement Mode
validation_enforcement_mode.description: Whether policy validation failures block deployment (enforced) or only produce warnings (advisory/audit).

policy_rule_count.title: Active Policy Rule Count
policy_rule_count.description: Number of active security policy rules loaded and evaluated during pre-deployment validation.

version_pinning_enforced.title: Version Pinning Enforced
version_pinning_enforced.description: Indicates whether all package and dependency declarations use exact, pinned versions rather than floating ranges or wildcards.

lockfile_present.title: Lockfile Present and Committed
lockfile_present.description: Indicates whether a dependency lockfile (e.g., package-lock.json, yarn.lock, Pipfile.lock, Gemfile.lock, go.sum) exists and is committed to source control.

pinning_scope.title: Pinning Scope Coverage
pinning_scope.description: Describes the breadth of version pinning across the dependency tree - whether pinning covers only direct dependencies, both direct and transitive, or is absent.

template_repository_exists.title: Configuration Template Repository Exists
template_repository_exists.description: Indicates whether a centralized, version-controlled repository of configuration templates exists and is actively used for provisioning.

version_control_enabled.title: Version Control Enabled on Templates
version_control_enabled.description: Indicates whether the configuration template repository uses version control (e.g., Git) with commit history and change tracking.

template_coverage_scope.title: Template Coverage Scope
template_coverage_scope.description: Describes the breadth of infrastructure or environment types covered by the configuration templates.

deployment_pipeline_integrated.title: Templates Integrated into Deployment Pipeline
deployment_pipeline_integrated.description: Indicates whether configuration templates are actively referenced and consumed by automated deployment or CI/CD pipelines.
